vocabulary.example: I am on the school team.
I exercise three times a week.
I play tennis and do yoga.

grammar.explanation_en: English uses different verbs for different types of sports: 'play' for ball games and team sports (play soccer, play tennis), 'do' for individual/martial activities (do yoga, do exercise), and 'go' for '-ing' activities (go swimming, go hiking).
grammar.explanation_ko: 영어는 스포츠 종류에 따라 다른 동사를 씁니다: 공놀이나 팀 스포츠에는 'play'(play soccer, play tennis), 개인 활동이나 무술류에는 'do'(do yoga, do exercise), '-ing'로 끝나는 활동에는 'go'(go swimming, go hiking)를 씁니다.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: Yes, I play soccer with my friends. I also go swimming sometimes.
dialogue.line_ko: 네, 친구들이랑 축구해요. 가끔 수영하러 가기도 해요.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.line: Did your team win last weekend?

reading.title: Staying Active
reading.text: I like to stay active. On Mondays, I do yoga. On Wednesdays, I play basketball with my team. On weekends, I go hiking with my family. Last week, my team won our basketball game. I was very happy.
reading.text_ko: 저는 활동적으로 지내는 것을 좋아해요. 월요일에는 요가를 해요. 수요일에는 팀과 농구를 해요. 주말에는 가족과 등산을 가요. 지난주에는 저희 팀이 농구 경기에서 이겼어요. 저는 아주 기뻤어요.

explanation.en: The text says 'On Mondays, I do yoga.'
explanation.ko: 본문에 'On Mondays, I do yoga.'라고 나옵니다.

explanation.en: The text says 'I go hiking with my family.'
The text says 'my team won our basketball game.'
